### Trust Without Reservation
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-6-7-2013.html
Passage: Isaiah 12:2
Points:
- True Christianity means resting fully in Christ rather than relying on self-effort.
- Genuine trust is like leaning your entire weight on crutches for support.
- Spiritual strength comes from adopting God's perspective over our limited understanding.
- Choosing wholehearted trust, prayer, and praise transforms us from within, even when circumstances do not change.

### The Power of a Song
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-august-29-2018.html
Passage: Isaiah 12:2
Points:
- Music connects to the core of our being and naturally prompts heartfelt worship.
- Scripture reveals that God Himself is our strength, our salvation, and our song.
- Singing God's praise is a practical way to fulfill the call to love Him completely.
- Even in mundane daily chores and distractions, believers can find joy and celebrate the Lord.
